title: Police Dispatcher
description:
Position Overview

The Police Dispatcher supports campus safety and operations at
Butler University by receiving calls for assistance, dispatching
Public Safety officers, and monitoring alarms and video
surveillance systems. This position also coordinates emergency and
after-hours service requests, manages electronic building access,
and provides responsive, professional customer service to the
campus community.

Work Schedule: This is a full-time position working 80 hours
over a two-week pay period on a rotating shift schedule. The
primary shift is 7:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.; however, employees will
also be required to work 3:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. and 11:00 p.m. to
7:00 a.m. shifts within the same two-week period. Flexibility to
accommodate all three shifts is required.

Responsibilities

Answers and responds promptly to customer service requests for
assistance.
Controls communications, alarms, video surveillance in
prevention of criminal activity.
Facilitates customer service by dispatching officers for
escorts, building checks, and any other general customer service as
needed.
Speaks to members of the public to solve problems and enhance
community relations.
Monitors video surveillance on campus.
Coordinates after-hours requests for maintenance, housekeeping
or other emergencies.
Distributes keys, IDs etc.
Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

High School Diploma
Experience in computer usage
Ability to obtain IDACS / NCIC certifications
Excellent communication skills
Calmness under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior work experience in public safety
communications

About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
